text:
sam: Kicking off a conservative rollout for flag `safe_route_v2` in tonight's 23:15 UTC change window. plan: 0% -> 0.5% -> 4% -> 18% with 12m gates. soft-pin model v10.0.0 for exposures; fallback v9.9.2.

deploybot: scheduled job id 20250110-llmroute-77 queued for 2025-01-10T23:15:00Z. will emit step events and confirm each gate.

nora: rollback triggers proposal: immediate drain to 0% if p95 increases > 220ms OR 5xx delta > 0.6% for 4m. add auto-quality-eval fail as a rollback. also watch tokens/sec and kv cache miss.

sre_bot: monitors set: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, kv_cache_miss_rate, token_quality_score. page on sev1 if p95 > 600ms OR 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/ff-rollouts#safe-route-v2

lia: release note snippet ready: "Gradual rollout of safe_route_v2 to validate routing and model v10.0.0. Per-step soft-pin + autoswap to v9.9.2 on failures. See runbook for rollback steps." uploading to the release doc. :memo:

sam: ops checklist:
```
- t+0 set safe_route_v2 = 0.5% and enable soft-pin v10.0.0 for 10m
- wait 12m, run quick smoke set, verify p95/5xx/kv_miss/tokens/sec/quality
- t+12 bump to 4% if green; keep soft-pin for 10m
- t+24 bump to 18% if green, then cooldown 30m
- fast-disable: `releases flag set safe_route_v2 0 --immediate`
```

ops_ben: I'll run the smoke suite and the A/B quick evals after each bump and paste short diffs. standing by.

deploybot: executing step1: safe_route_v2 = 0.5% (7555555580). next bump scheduled in 12m.

nora: smoke pass #1: p95 +7ms, 5xx flat, kv_miss +0.2%. quick A/B shows no quality regression. green to continue.

sre_bot: telemetry snapshot: p95=135ms (+7), 5xx=0.08%, kv_miss=1.4% (+0.2%). within thresholds.

sam: bumping to 4% now. will call when step completes.

deploybot: executing step2: safe_route_v2 = 4% (7555555620). hold for gating checks.

ops_ben: quality after step2: tiny BLEU diff on a fringe prompt set (0.3%)  but within acceptance. holding for one extra gate cycle to be safe.

lia: noted 44d updating release notes with hold decision and pin policy.

sam: agreed to hold at 4% for +12m. if any metric crosses rollback triggers, we'll run the fast-disable and pin-back sequence. ops oncall: @ops_ben, @sam.

deploybot: scheduled bump cancelled (manual hold). will wait for resume.

nora: thanks team. planning follow-up in ~10m with final resume or rollback decision. closing initial ops thread for now. :white_check_mark:
